blocks.text: The Municipal Judge may correct an illegal sentence at any time. Clerical mistakes in judgments or orders may be corrected by the court at any time. (Ord. 20206 § 9, 9-10-19; Ord. 17666 § 68, 3-27-01. Code 1995 § 50-103. Formerly 2.110.650.)
State Law References: Similar statute, K.S.A. 12-4513 .
